_comment: Golden fixture for community-strats wiring into propose_strategies (AC-1..AC-7). Input shapes and invariants only — no producer-computed metric values hardcoded. All numeric values in this fixture are TEST INPUTS provided to the module, never derived from module output.

cap_constant.description: MAX_COMMUNITY_CANDIDATES_PER_RUN — implementer picks the value; tests assert the constant exists and the cap is enforced

injection_contract.description: community candidates flow through all 5 steps of propose_strategies (AC-2)
steps: backtested via run_backtest (same as template candidates)
included in evaluate_candidate_batch input (FDR gate sees them)
persisted with template_id=community when they survive

sharpe_filtered_key.description: AC-7: load_community_strategies stats must gain a sharpe_filtered counter
sharpe_filtered_key.invariant: pulled == valid + deduped + missing_edn_string + parse_failed + validate_rejected + sharpe_filtered
sharpe_filtered_key.filter_condition: doc has oos_metrics.sharpe present AND sharpe < min_oos_sharpe threshold
